scientific_integrity: The orbital-ceiling and monotonic-lag claims are derived analytically in RESULT.md; numerical tests are supporting stress tests only. Qualitative delay, Kepler forcing and the standard linear filter are acknowledged prior art.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for a stationary scalar linear relaxation of globally averaged inverse-square forcing; not for nonlinear atmospheres, rotating hot spots, measured light curves, transient states or circular orbits. Inversion is ill-conditioned as response time grows and amplitude vanishes. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Strict thermal-peak lag and an eccentric-orbit ceiling in a linear radiative proxy
